limitations: Atom-PDOS threshold onsets are spectral proxies; isolated-layer band projections and transmission are not available.
Finite periodic wire array geometry: F15 maximum Mo-column clearance 13.59 A; R15 maximum Mo-column clearance 14.49 A.
Within-cell strip comparisons do not establish a recovered bulk-like channel or lateral-size/k-mesh convergence.
PBE-DZP, NoSpin without explicit SOC; fixed supplied geometries. These are not quasiparticle or measured barriers.
F15/R15 differ in Au count, wire width, height, contact area and sheet deformation; no isolated shape/facet effect is established.
Legacy group names are retained for exact method parity; consult physical clearances for actual exposure.
In-gap contact PDOS does not define a unique vertical band-edge barrier.
Hole onsets can be substantially threshold-sensitive; report primary envelopes alongside the baseline.
Gaussian smoothing is a postprocessing sensitivity test, not an assumed physical lifetime or temperature broadening.
